content: Implement URL slugs for our documentation importer. Keep ASCII letters and digits; every run of other characters becomes one dash. Trim leading and trailing dashes. Casing is significant: API and api refer to different existing documents.
A conventional slug helper would lowercase text. I initially proposed lowercasing before stripping punctuation.
Reject the lowercasing proposal. Existing URLs are case-sensitive. For example, API / v2 Guide must produce API-v2-Guide, not api-v2-guide. Keep this requirement when you finish punctuation handling.
I removed the lowercase call. The checkpoint now only joins whitespace. Punctuation handling is still pending.
Checkpoint probe: slug("API Guide") -> "API-Guide"; slug("release / notes") -> "release-/-notes".
Check the current behavior on extra whitespace before continuing.
Whitespace is collapsed already. I will fix punctuation without replacing the whole importer.
Finish the remaining punctuation handling in slug.py. Run the public smoke checks.
The remaining edit is in slug(); there are no dependencies or extra files to change.
